prompt: The mean of $\{2, 4, 6\}$ is $4$. If you add the value $12$ to the data, what is the new mean?
hint: Find the new sum, then divide by the new count.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Sort the data from least to greatest first — many statistics get easy after that.
Find the new sum, then divide by the new count.
Old sum $= 12$. New sum $= 24$. New count $= 4$.
